# PuroClean Canada

> > Canada's property restoration experts specializing in water damage, fire damage, and mould remediation with I.I.C.R.C. certified professionals and the QuickDry System.

PuroClean Canada operates a nationwide franchise network providing emergency restoration services across Ontario and beyond, partnering with the Canadian Red Cross for disaster response. Their restoration specialists use advanced technologies including HEPA filtration, ozone generators, hydroxyl generators, and foggers to restore properties after water, fire, and mould damage.
